title: rag.py pack ranks a table's rows before its budget cut
goal: pack prints a CSV article's matching rows by score, not in file order, before it cuts at the character budget, so a question about one model reaches its row of kb/public/claude/models.csv; today a Claude Opus 5.5 model question never reaches models.csv although its row is on line 4, and ST-dtqlqjs7 moved the Haiku 5.5 row to the first data row to be cited. Found in SP-hm4qgf3t's run and confirmed by its review.

run: import subprocess,sys; p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','pack','Claude Opus 5.5 model id context window max output'],capture_output=True,text=True); sys.exit(0 if p.returncode==0 and 'models.csv' in p.stdout else 1)
